title: Smoked Salmon Dip

items.text: 8 oz block cream cheese, softened to room temperature
1½ tbsp fresh lemon juice (about half a lemon)
1 garlic clove, minced (or ¼ tsp garlic powder)
4 oz smoked salmon fillet, fully cooked
Herb of your choice — see If You Feel Like It
½ tsp hot sauce, like Tabasco (if you feel like it)

steps.text: Let the 8 oz cream cheese sit out 20–30 minutes.
steps.donenessCue: Presses easily with a finger, no cold lumps.

steps.text: Flake the 4 oz salmon with a fork, removing any skin. Aim for mostly fine crumbles with a few larger chunks.
Beat the softened cream cheese with the 3 tbsp buttermilk until smooth. Add the 1½ tbsp lemon juice and garlic. Stir until combined.
Add the salmon, 2 tbsp chives, your chosen herb, and ¼ tsp pepper. Fold gently — distributed, not pulverized. Taste, and add the ½ tsp hot sauce if you want heat.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Serve cold, topped with extra chives.

ifYouFeelLikeIt: Herb options (instead of dill): double the chives, flat-leaf parsley, tarragon (about half as much — it’s stronger), ¼ tsp smoked paprika, or 1 tsp horseradish for a bagel-and-lox vibe.
Smoother: hand-mix the cream cheese before folding. Chunkier: fold by hand and don’t overwork it.
Serve with crackers, bagel chips, cucumber rounds, or bell pepper strips.
storage: Covered in the fridge up to 3 days. Stir if it separates slightly.
